assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional rough boundaries, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are internally reproducible but non-statutory and must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Replace official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons, then regenerate all design layers, metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, parcel ownership, utilities, fire, flood, heritage and engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, floor area, building height, road area, setbacks, demolition decisions, infrastructure capacity and approval conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual spatial components rather than surveyed existing buildings or approved projects.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish wording is a method for later survey and cannot determine a specific parcel action.

assumptions.statement: Mobility lines show desired walking, cycling and service relationships, not road or rail engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Every crossing, station interface, accessibility detail and emergency route needs professional survey and review.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, scenario access and operator roles are governance proposals.
assumptions.impact: They imply no organizer, government, enterprise, funding or calendar commitment.
